trs.20: The Most Merciful
trs.85: It is the Lord of Mercy
trs.22: (Allah) Most Gracious!
trs.203: The Most Gracious (Allâh)!

trs.20: Taught the Qur’ān,
trs.85: who taught the Quran.
trs.22: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
trs.203: He has taught (you mankind) the Qur’ân (by His Mercy).

trs.20: Created man,
trs.85: He created man
trs.22: He has created man:
trs.203: He created man.

trs.20: [And] taught him eloquence.
trs.85: and taught him to communicate.
trs.22: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
trs.203: He taught him eloquent speech.

trs.20: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
trs.85: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;
trs.22: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
trs.203: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning).

trs.20: And the stars and trees prostrate.<sup foot_note=197468>1</sup>
trs.85: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;
trs.22: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
trs.203: And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate themselves (to Allah - See V.22:18) (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

trs.20: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
trs.85: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance
trs.22: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
trs.203: And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.

trs.20: That you not transgress within the balance.
trs.85: so that you may not exceed in the balance:
trs.22: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
trs.203: In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ

trs.20: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
trs.85: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.
trs.22: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
trs.203: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

trs.20: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
trs.85: He set down the Earth for His creatures,
trs.22: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
trs.203: And the earth: He has put down (laid) for the creatures.

trs.20: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
trs.85: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,
trs.22: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
trs.203: Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).

trs.20: And grain having husks and scented plants.
trs.85: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.
trs.22: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
trs.203: And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?<sup foot_note=197469>1</sup>
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
trs.85: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,
trs.22: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
trs.203: He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.

verses.text_uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ

trs.20: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
trs.85: the jinn out of smokeless fire.
trs.22: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
trs.203: And the jinn: He created from a smokeless flame of fire.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.<sup foot_note=197470>1</sup>
trs.85: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.
trs.22: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
trs.203: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: He released the two seas,<sup foot_note=197471>1</sup> meeting [one another];
trs.85: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,
trs.22: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
trs.203: He has let loose the two seas (the salt and fresh water) meeting together.

trs.20: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.
trs.85: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.
trs.22: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
trs.203: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
trs.85: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.
trs.22: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
trs.203: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ

trs.20: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
trs.85: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.
trs.22: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
trs.203: And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
trs.85: Everyone on earth perishes;
trs.22: All that is on earth will perish:
trs.203: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

trs.20: And there will remain the Face<sup foot_note=197472>1</sup> of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
trs.85: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
trs.22: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
trs.203: And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ

trs.20: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.<sup foot_note=197473>1</sup>
trs.85: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.
trs.22: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
trs.203: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He is (engaged) in some affair (such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)!

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.<sup foot_note=197474>1</sup>
trs.85: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].
trs.22: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
trs.203: We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinn and men)!

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ

trs.20: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
trs.85: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.
trs.22: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
trs.203: O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allâh)!

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ

trs.20: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke,<sup foot_note=197475>1</sup> and you will not defend yourselves.
trs.85: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.
trs.22: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
trs.203: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

translation.text: you will (be able to) defend yourselves

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ

trs.20: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil<sup foot_note=197476>1</sup> -
trs.85: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.
trs.22: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
trs.203: Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes rosy or red like red-oil, or red hide - [See V.70:8]

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

trs.20: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.<sup foot_note=197477>1</sup>
trs.85: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.
trs.22: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin.
trs.203: So on that Day no question will be asked of man or jinns as to his sin, [because they have already been known from their faces either white (dwellers of Paradise - true believers of Islamic Monotheism) or black (dwellers of Hell - polytheists; disbelievers, criminals)].

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ

trs.20: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
trs.85: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.
trs.22: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
trs.203: The Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) will be known by their marks (black faces), and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ

trs.20: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
trs.85: This is the Hell the guilty deny,
trs.22: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny:
trs.203: This is the Hell which the Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) denied.

trs.20: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
trs.85: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water.
trs.22: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round!
trs.203: They will go between it (Hell) and the fierce boiling water!

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord<sup foot_note=197478>1</sup> are two gardens -
trs.85: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens.
trs.22: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens-
trs.203: But for him who<sup foot_note=154955>1</sup> fears the standing before his Lord, there will be two Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).<sup foot_note=154956>2</sup>

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: Having [spreading] branches.
trs.85: With shading branches.
trs.22: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
trs.203: With spreading branches.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
trs.85: With a pair of flowing springs.
trs.22: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free);
trs.203: In them (both) will be two springs flowing (free).

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
trs.85: With every kind of fruit in pairs.
trs.22: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two.
trs.203: In them (both) will be every kind of fruit in pairs.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ

trs.20: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
trs.85: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach.
trs.22: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
trs.203: Reclining upon the couches lined with silk brocade, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

trs.20: In them are women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note=197480>1</sup> untouched<sup foot_note=197479>2</sup> before them by man or jinnī -
trs.85: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
trs.22: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
trs.203: Wherein both will be Qâsirât-ut-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances, desiring none except their husbands], with whom no man or jinni has had tamth<sup foot_note=154957>1</sup> before them.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: As if they were rubies and coral.<sup foot_note=197481>1</sup>
trs.85: Like rubies and brilliant pearls.
trs.22: Like unto Rubies and coral.
trs.203: (In beauty) they are like rubies and coral.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
trs.85: Shall the reward of good be anything but good?
trs.22: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good?
trs.203: Is there any reward for good other than good?

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
trs.85: There are two other gardens below these two.
trs.22: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens,-
trs.203: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: Dark green [in color].
trs.85: Both of deepest green.
trs.22: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering).
trs.203: Dark green (in colour).

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
trs.85: With a pair of gushing springs.
trs.22: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
trs.203: In them (both) will be two springs gushing forth.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
trs.85: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees.
trs.22: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates:
trs.203: In them (both) will be fruits, and date-palms and pomegranates.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: In them are good and beautiful women -
trs.85: There are good-natured, beautiful maidens.
trs.22: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful;-
trs.203: Therein (Gardens) will be Khairâtun-Hisân [fair (wives) good and beautiful];

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

trs.20: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
trs.85: Dark-eyed, sheltered in pavilions.
trs.22: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions;-
trs.203: Hûr<sup foot_note=154958>1</sup> (beautiful, fair females) guarded in pavilions;

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ

trs.20: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
trs.85: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
trs.22: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
trs.203: With whom no man or jinni has had tamth<sup foot_note=154959>1</sup> before them.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ

trs.20: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
trs.85: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.
trs.22: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
trs.203: Reclining on green cushions and rich beautiful mattresses.

trs.20: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
trs.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
trs.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
trs.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

verses.text_uthmani: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ

trs.20: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
trs.85: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
trs.22: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
trs.203: Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allâh), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.
